name: Scarlet Dawn

targets.description: every creature in the Cylinder, friend or foe

summary: Crimson light falls in a 20-foot-radius, 60-foot-high Cylinder: creatures that are not Constructs or Undead make a Con save or take 4d10 Necrotic (half on a success); Constructs and Undead regain 4d10 Hit Points. It dispels Darkness of level 3 or lower.
text: Crimson light shines down in a 20-foot-radius, 60-foot-high Cylinder centred on a point within 120 feet. Each creature in it that is not a Construct or Undead makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 4d10 Necrotic damage on a failure or half as much on a success. Each Construct and Undead in it regains 4d10 Hit Points instead. There is no choosing: it hurts living allies and heals Construct and Undead foes alike. Any magical Darkness in the area created by a spell of level 3 or lower is dispelled. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: the damage increases by 1d10, and the level of Darkness spell it can dispel by 1, for each slot level above 3.
